steps.title: LEFT JOIN, анти-джойны и UPDATE
steps.content:
## Ещё раз про JOIN и DML

- **Анти-джойн**: `LEFT JOIN … WHERE right.id IS NULL` — «у левого нет пары».
- **`NOT IN` + подзапрос** — «нет ни одной связанной записи с условием».
- **`COALESCE(SUM(x), 0)`** — ноль вместо `NULL` при `LEFT JOIN`.
- **`UPDATE … SET col = CASE WHEN … END`** — DML-задачи проверяются по состоянию таблицы после запроса.

content.caption: LEFT JOIN + IS NULL отсеивает пары
content.description: Анти-джойн возвращает строки левой таблицы без совпадений.

content.description:
Для каждой записи `Person` верните `firstName`, `lastName`, `city`, `state`; если адреса нет — `NULL`. Сортировка по `personId`.

[LeetCode 175](https://leetcode.com/problems/combine-two-tables/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Person(personId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, lastName TEXT NOT NULL, firstName TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Address(addressId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, personId INTEGER NOT NULL, city TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT p.firstName, p.lastName, a.city, a.state FROM Person p JOIN Address a ON p.personId = a.personId ORDER BY p.personId;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT p.firstName, p.lastName, a.city, a.state FROM Person p LEFT JOIN Address a ON p.personId = a.personId ORDER BY p.personId;

steps.title: 181. Employees Earning More Than Their Managers

content.description:
Верните `name` сотрудников, которые зарабатывают **больше** своего менеджера. Колонка `Employee`.

[LeetCode 181](https://leetcode.com/problems/employees-earning-more-than-their-managers/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employee(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, salary INTEGER NOT NULL, managerId INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT e.name AS Employee FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.managerId = m.id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT e.name AS Employee FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.managerId = m.id WHERE e.salary > m.salary;

content.description:
Клиенты, не сделавшие **ни одного** заказа. Верните `name` с псевдонимом `Customers`, сортировка по `id`.

[LeetCode 183](https://leetcode.com/problems/customers-who-never-order/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Customers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customerId INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT c.name AS Customers FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.id = o.customerId ORDER BY c.id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT c.name AS Customers FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON c.id = o.customerId WHERE o.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.id;

content.description:
Имя продавца (`name`), у которого **нет** ни одного заказа от компании с именем `RED`.

[LeetCode 607](https://leetcode.com/problems/sales-person/)
content.starterCode: SELECT s.name FROM SalesPerson s JOIN Orders o ON s.sales_id = o.sales_id JOIN Company c ON o.com_id = c.com_id WHERE c.name = 'RED';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT s.name FROM SalesPerson s WHERE s.sales_id NOT IN (SELECT o.sales_id FROM Orders o JOIN Company c ON o.com_id = c.com_id WHERE c.name = 'RED');

content.description:
Поменяйте значения `sex` (`m` ↔ `f`) одним `UPDATE` — без промежуточной таблицы. Проверяется состояние таблицы после запроса.

[LeetCode 627](https://leetcode.com/problems/swap-salary/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Salary(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, sex TEXT NOT NULL, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: UPDATE Salary SET sex = CASE WHEN sex = 'm' THEN 'f' ELSE 'm' END;

tests.seed: INSERT INTO Salary VALUES (1,'X','m',100);
INSERT INTO Salary VALUES (1,'Y','f',100),(2,'Z','m',200);

content.checkQuery: SELECT id, name, sex, salary FROM Salary ORDER BY id;

content.description:
Для каждого `name`: `travelled_distance` — суммарная дистанция, `0` если поездок не было. Сортировка по дистанции убыв., затем по имени возр.

[LeetCode 1407](https://leetcode.com/problems/top-travellers/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Rides(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, distance INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT u.name, SUM(r.distance) AS travelled_distance FROM Users u JOIN Rides r ON u.id = r.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY travelled_distance DESC, u.name ASC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT u.name, COALESCE(SUM(r.distance), 0) AS travelled_distance FROM Users u LEFT JOIN Rides r ON u.id = r.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY travelled_distance DESC, u.name ASC;

content.description:
Для каждого покупателя: `buyer_id`, `join_date` и `orders_in_2019` — число заказов за 2019 год (`0`, если заказов нет). Сортировка по `buyer_id`.

[LeetCode 1158](https://leetcode.com/problems/market-analysis-i/)
content.starterCode: SELECT u.user_id AS buyer_id, u.join_date, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_in_2019 FROM Users u JOIN Orders o ON u.user_id = o.buyer_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2019' GROUP BY u.user_id ORDER BY u.user_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT u.user_id AS buyer_id, u.join_date, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_in_2019 FROM Users u LEFT JOIN Orders o ON u.user_id = o.buyer_id AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2019' GROUP BY u.user_id ORDER BY u.user_id;

steps.title: 3570. Find Books with No Available Copies

content.description:
Книги, которые **сейчас на руках** (`return_date IS NULL`) и у которых не осталось свободных экземпляров (число невозвращённых = `total_copies`). Колонки `book_id`, `title`, `author`, `genre`, `publication_year`, `current_borrowers`; сортировка по `current_borrowers` убыв., затем `title` возр.

[LeetCode 3570](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-books-with-no-available-copies/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE library_books(book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, author TEXT NOT NULL, genre TEXT NOT NULL, publication_year INTEGER NOT NULL, total_copies INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE borrowing_records(record_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, book_id INTEGER NOT NULL, borrower_name TEXT NOT NULL, borrow_date TEXT NOT NULL, return_date TEXT);
content.starterCode: SELECT b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.genre, b.publication_year, COUNT(*) AS current_borrowers FROM library_books b JOIN borrowing_records r ON b.book_id = r.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id ORDER BY current_borrowers DESC, b.title ASC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.genre, b.publication_year, COUNT(*) AS current_borrowers FROM library_books b JOIN borrowing_records r ON b.book_id = r.book_id AND r.return_date IS NULL GROUP BY b.book_id HAVING COUNT(*) = b.total_copies ORDER BY current_borrowers DESC, b.title ASC;
